hypothesis: Compare both published UPDC iterations against the frozen previous SWarp validation leader on common sky support with explicit static-metric limits
source_kind: published and archived mosaics; reference is not truth
commands:
import pathlib,subprocess,sys
source=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1])
subprocess.check_call([sys.executable,'-c','import runpy,sys;runpy.run_path(sys.argv[1])["_ensure_local_cpp"]()',str(source/'scripts/run_local_sphere_bench.py')])
subprocess.check_call([sys.executable,'-c','
import hashlib,json,pathlib,runpy,sys
source=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); output=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[2])
print("fresh experiment interpreter",sys.executable,flush=True)
import torch,torchsky
from torchsky.map import ImageObservation,coadd_image_plane,evaluate_map_product,field_image_quality_metrics
arc=pathlib.Path("/arc/projects/ots/torchsky-runs")
published=arc/"smacs-inr-autonomous-20261010/smacs-published-updc-map-metrics-20261011-r2"
prior=arc/"20260729-smacs-sixband-controls-3ff8604"
header_path=arc/"20260729-smacs-validation-32e0940/validation-000/common-support-r9-f0p99.fits"
_,header=torchsky.read(str(header_path),return_header=True); header=dict(header)
report={"profile":"published-updc-vs-frozen-best-stack","reference":"archived SWarp Lanczos3 (previous validation leader)","reference_is_truth":False,"depth_claim":False,"target_header_sha256":hashlib.sha256(header_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"limitations":["Published images and archived stack may use different exposure and calibration histories", "Image agreement SNR is not detection SNR", "Sharpness is not an effective PSF", "Flux agreement is not a calibrated injection-conservation measurement", "Bilinear alignment changes small-scale noise and sharpness"],"rows":[]}
for band in ("F090W","F150W","F200W","F277W","F356W","F444W"):
 science=prior/band/"products/swarp_lanczos3_sci.fits"; weight=prior/band/"products/swarp_lanczos3_wht.fits"
 reference=coadd_image_plane([ImageObservation(path=str(science),weight_path=str(weight))],target_header=header,resampling_kernel="bilinear",value_semantics="surface_brightness",stacking_method="weighted_mean",spatial_tile_hw=(128,128))
 products={}
 for iteration in (0,10):
  data,h=torchsky.read(str(published/band/f"iter{iteration}_sci.fits"),return_header=True)
  support=torchsky.read(str(published/band/f"iter{iteration}_support.fits"))
  assert str(h.get("BUNIT","")).replace(" ","").lower()=="mjy/sr"
  probe=torch.tensor([[0.,0.],[511.,511.],[255.5,255.5]],dtype=torch.float64)
  assert torch.allclose(torchsky.WCS(dict(h)).pixel_to_world(probe),torchsky.WCS(header).pixel_to_world(probe),rtol=0.,atol=1e-9)
  products[iteration]=(data,support)
 mask=(reference.weight>0)&torch.isfinite(reference.data)
 for data,support in products.values(): mask&=(support>0)&torch.isfinite(data)
 assert bool(mask.any()),band
 for iteration,(data,support) in products.items():
  metrics=field_image_quality_metrics(data,reference.data,mask=mask)
  metrics.update(evaluate_map_product(data,reference.data,weight=mask.float(),header=header,value_semantics="surface_brightness"))
  values=data[mask]
  metrics["negative_pixel_fraction"]=float((values<0).float().mean())
  metrics["negative_to_positive_flux_ratio"]=float((-values.clamp(max=0)).sum()/values.clamp(min=0).sum())
  metrics["common_support_flux_ratio_vs_swarp"]=float(values.sum()/reference.data[mask].sum())
  paths=(published/band/f"iter{iteration}_sci.fits",science,weight)
  report["rows"].append({"band":band,"published_iteration":iteration,"common_support_pixels":int(mask.sum()),"input_sha256":{str(p):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in paths},"metrics_vs_swarp":metrics})
 (output/"published-best-stack.json").write_text(json.dumps(report,indent=2,allow_nan=False)+"\n")
 print("published vs best stack complete",band,flush=True)
',*sys.argv[1:]])
